name: Lookups
description: Search fields for your Workspace views: type a title, pick a suggestion, its data becomes a row — films and series, books, Wikipedia, Google's Knowledge Graph and web results. What you type goes to that service.
author: Zeff

settings.label: TMDB API key
settings.help: Optional: without it films come from Wikidata and Wikipedia, series from TVmaze. Free at themoviedb.org → Settings → API (key or read access token). This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

settings.label: Google API key
settings.help: For Google Books and the Knowledge Graph: a key from console.cloud.google.com with the Books API and the Knowledge Graph Search API switched on.
